method: MVH reading recovery by outline matching against its own Latin glyphs, with visually transcribed exceptions. Only the resulting reading table is a build input; all generated name glyphs are composites of the main UI font. No MVH or XF outlines are embedded.
unknown_text_readings: Keep unknown characters; the scoped composite Font retains the original simsun fallback.
credits: LangNhan aka LyMocQuan (legacy MVH font metadata)
MVH conversion font distribution in the project

supplement_sources.title: WinVNKey Han-Viet database 3.04, Thanh Sơn Lê and credited contributors

default_selection: One common default per character; explicit preferred readings, MVH base, dictionary main Mandarin correspondence, then shared dictionary/Unihan reading or most widespread candidate in the MVH reading inventory. Simplified/traditional and compatibility aliases inherit an existing reading. No name-context guessing and no XF input.
reviewed_corrections: Explicit common readings replace known semantic translations and transcription errors in the MVH table; preferred readings take precedence. Unlisted polyphony keeps one default per character.
